Subject: Field Drive badge scanner integration — quick overview

Hi Sean,

Thanks for taking this — Renegade is running a regional Field Drive in October (9 venues across the US) and we want to capture badge scans to enrich HubSpot contact records in near-real-time. High level:
- Devices: mix of on-site badge scanners (ProxBadge v2) and a QR form fallback.
- Volume: ~40k scans across the run, peak ~1200/hr at larger venues.
- Primary need: reliable transfer of opt-in consent, timestamped scan records, and campaign attribution fields into HubSpot (we still use SFDC for enterprise deals but HubSpot owns the lead flow).

Questions:
1) Can Redwood ingest scanner webhook exports and push to HubSpot?
2) What consent language/fields do you recommend for post-scan opt-in?
3) Any offline/edge sync concerns if venue internet is flaky?

I attached a sanitized sample export from our scanner vendor.

Thanks — can we get a quick 30-min discovery early next week?

Olivia
Director, Partnerships
Renegade Events

From: sean.gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood-inference.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, ben_carter@redwood-inference.com
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Field Drive badge scanner integration — quick overview

Hi Olivia — great to meet you over email. Happy to run discovery.

Short answers up front:
- Yes, Redwood can ingest scanner exports/webhooks and map fields into HubSpot; we also support transient offline caching for edge devices and replay once connectivity returns.
- Recommended consent: a single explicit opt-in flag (consent_given=true), timestamp, and consent_text reference id (so you can swap language without re-ingesting records). We can store raw snapshot of the consent language along with the contact record for audit.
- For noisy/edge venues we recommend device-level buffering + sequence numbers to avoid duplicates; Redwood can do dedupe at ingest using (device_id, scan_id).

Can you share: expected CSV/JSON schema for the scanner, sample consent language you plan to display, and HubSpot portal ID? I dropped Marissa (our event ops) and Ben (integrations lead) on the thread — they'll own mapping and vendor handshake.

I can do 30 minutes next Monday (14th) 10:00–11:00 PT. Works for you?

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Field Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Hi all — thanks for the sync earlier. Per our call, I put together a short MAP and a first-pass HubSpot field mapping. Key points below; attached is a spreadsheet with the mapping and field-level examples.

High-level MAP (timeline):
- 9/14–9/20: confirm final scanner schema + consent wording (OWNER: Renegade)
- 9/21–9/28: Redwood build & sandbox ingest; HubSpot test mapping (OWNER: Redwood/Ben)
- 10/01–10/07: On-site pilot at Venue A (live ingest + fallbacks)
- 10/10–onward: Scale to remaining venues

Field mapping summary:
- scan_id -> contact property: redwood_scan_id (string)
- device_id -> redwood_device_id (string)
- scan_timestamp -> last_touch_scan (datetime)
- consent_flag -> redwood_consent (boolean)
- consent_text_id -> redwood_consent_snapshot_id (string)
- campaign_code -> campaign_source (string)

Dedupe behavior: we will prefer HubSpot email if present; otherwise create lead with redwood_scan_id as external ID and partner source tag.

Attachments: field_drive_map_v1.xlsx (contains mapping + sample transforms)

Next steps I need from Renegade:

- HubSpot portal ID + test credentials (we generally work with a staging API key)

Ben will follow up separately on the webhook handshake and auth.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
